sources.title: Homotopy classification of 4-manifolds with finite abelian 2-generator fundamental groups
sources.independent_inspection: Publisher HTML and current arXiv record inspected; no independently downloaded PDF pin.
sources.finding: Oriented finite Poincare 4-complexes with finite pi and abelian Sylow 2-subgroup generated by at most two elements. Also the torsion-free Gamma coinvariant criterion. HK gives 4-periodic finite groups; Bauer requires 4-periodic Sylow 2-subgroup. Reported Gamma computations were not rerun.

sources.title: Homotopy classification of 4-manifolds whose fundamental group is dihedral
sources.independent_inspection: Current primary arXiv abstract and bibliographic record inspected; no full proof inspection or PDF hash.
sources.finding: Finite oriented Poincare 4-complexes with finite fundamental group having a dihedral Sylow 2-subgroup. The statement is broader than dihedral fundamental groups.

sources.title: Quotients of S2 x S2
sources.independent_inspection: Publisher DOI reader returned an error; primary arXiv v3 HTML Section 3 and record independently inspected instead. No PDF hash.
sources.finding: For a realized quadratic 2-type with finite pi, the torsion subgroup acts freely and transitively on polarized types. Forgetting polarization uses Aut(B,w,lambda) orbits, rather than torsor cardinality alone.

sources.title: Four-manifolds, two-complexes and the quadratic bias invariant
sources.independent_inspection: Current primary arXiv v3 HTML and abstract/journal record inspected; no PDF hash.
sources.finding: Finite G; the class of doubles of minimal finite 2-complexes. Equal quadratic 2-types imply equal quadratic bias. No reverse implication. The additional torsion parameter remains an explicitly stated open issue in this source.

sources.title: Closed manifold surgery obstructions and the Oozing Conjecture
sources.independent_inspection: Pinned cached PDF independently hashed and freshly text-extracted identically; version banner, Corollary D and Remark 1.4 inspected. Current arXiv record shows v1 and no journal reference.
sources.finding: Provides finite 2-groups with differing surgery-kernel conditions. Via KNV it supplies ordinary-equivalent examples lacking simple equivalence, not ordinary homotopy inequivalence.

sources.title: Stable equivalence relations on 4-manifolds
sources.independent_inspection: Pinned cached v2 PDF independently hashed and freshly text-extracted identically. Version banner, Theorem C, Remark 1.4 inspected; current arXiv record and journal metadata checked.
sources.finding: Theorem C already posits ordinary equivalence. The smooth construction uses pi*pi; Remark 1.4 also distinguishes topological realizations over pi. Neither is a counterexample to ordinary equivalence in KP-4.55.

sources.title: Some remarks on h-cobordisms between smooth 4-manifolds
sources.independent_inspection: Pinned cached v2 PDF independently hashed and freshly text-extracted identically; pp.1-2 inspected; primary v2 HTML and current arXiv record checked.
sources.finding: Smooth compact connected oriented 4-manifold with finite pi. Conditions: SK1=0 plus injectivity L5s->L5h; or SK1=0 plus topological pre-stabilization; or smooth pre-stabilization. The conclusion realizes inertial h-cobordism torsion and upgrades existing smooth h-cobordisms under those hypotheses.

sources.title: Homotopy classification of 4-manifolds with 3-manifold fundamental group
sources.independent_inspection: Current v1 HTML Introduction, Definition 1.2, Theorem 1.4 and Section 2.1/Theorem 2.1 inspected; current abstract record checked. No PDF fingerprint claimed in the author packet.
sources.finding: Admissible means w vanishes on finite-order elements and every prime 3-manifold summand with torsion group is a lens space or S1 x RP2. This does not cover arbitrary finite groups. Fundamental-triple theorem is a separate cited input. Original Section 1.1 pointer corrected.

sources.title: Homotopy classification of 4-manifolds with fundamental group Z/p semidirect Z
sources.independent_inspection: Current v1 HTML and arXiv record inspected. No PDF hash.
sources.finding: For odd prime p, closed connected topological 4-manifolds with infinite group Z/p semidirect Z are classified using quadratic 2-type plus a compatible Z/p-valued intersection form. Does not establish an unrestricted finite-group classification.
